snippet.title: ButtonMan Trailer IndieMania 2026
snippet.description: Button Man is an adventure game set in 1920's Halifax Nova Scotia that combines the old classic point & click formula with beat 'em up combat and deep narrative choices. You play as Bruce Mckenzie, enforcer to the local mob boss, who is on the case to find out who killed his boss. Alongside a slew of colorful characters including a nosy reporter, a foreign actress, and a jazz club owner, you will solve the town's mysteries, find the killer, and protect the town.
